description: This file defines a mock GraphQL server for testing purposes, including matchers for queries and mutations, response constructors, and an HTTP client that intercepts requests to simulate server responses.

classes.name: Matcher
classes.description: Represents a GraphQL request matcher with request string, variables, and response.

classes.name: GQLResponse
classes.description: Represents a mocked GraphQL response, including data and errors.

methods.name: NewQueryMatcher
methods.description: Creates a new matcher for a GraphQL query with optional string conversion.

methods.name: NewMutationMatcher
methods.description: Creates a new matcher for a GraphQL mutation with input handling.

methods.name: DataResponse
methods.description: Constructs a successful mock response with data.

methods.name: ErrorResponse
methods.description: Constructs an error mock response with a message.

methods.name: githubv4InputStructToMap
methods.description: Converts a struct to a map[string]any using JSON marshalling.

methods.name: NewMockedHTTPClient
methods.description: Creates an HTTP client that intercepts /graphql POST requests and returns mock responses based on matchers.

methods.name: parseBody
methods.description: Parses the request body into a gqlRequest struct.

methods.name: Ptr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the given value.
